property_summary: For any depositor with a positive balance and any withdrawal amount in the admissible range (0 < amount <= balance), CashOut must succeed and leave balances[msg.sender] = balance - amount; the buggy version reverts specifically at amount == balance, so the rule fails for the exact-balance case.
change_summary: Change the CashOut permission check from `_am <= balances[msg.sender]` to `_am < balances[msg.sender]` so exact-balance withdrawals revert instead of completing.
